text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Obesity is defined as having a body-mass index (BMI) equal to, or greater than, 30. BMI is a person's weight (in
kilograms) divided by their height (in meters) squared.

tspan.tspan: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026)
To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
